<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>Anthropic.SDK</id>
    <version>5.10.0</version>
    <title>Claude API</title>
    <authors>Grant Hamm</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>
    <icon>icon.png</icon>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/tghamm/Anthropic.SDK</projectUrl>
    <description>A C# / .NET library to use with Anthropic's Claude API.  Supports Streaming, Tools, Batching, and Semantic Kernel/Agent Framework</description>
    <releaseNotes>Opus/Sonnet 4.6 Series, Adaptive Thinking, Costing, Web Search/Fetch, Bug Fixes, Latest M.E.AI.</releaseNotes>
    <copyright>This library is licensed MIT, in the public domain</copyright>
    <tags>Claude, AI, ML, API, Anthropic</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/tghamm/Anthropic.SDK" branch="refs/heads/main" commit="3b798b4231654f09fd8628225d88d14bda9aa93c" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net8.0">
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Bcl.AsyncInterfaces" version="10.0.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Abstractions" version="10.3.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
      <group targetFramework="net10.0">
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Bcl.AsyncInterfaces" version="10.0.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Abstractions" version="10.3.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
      <group targetFramework=".NETStandard2.0">
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Bcl.AsyncInterfaces" version="10.0.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.CSharp" version="4.7.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Abstractions" version="10.3.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="System.Text.Json" version="10.0.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
